name: Britannia nut and raisin cake
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (maida), Eggs, Sugar, Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil & Refined Palmolein Oil, Raisins (8.8%), Humectants (420(i) & 422], Orange Peel, Almond Nuts (2.7%), Invert Sugar Syrup, High Maltose Syrup, Butter (1.7%), Sweetened Condensed Milk, Cake Gel (emulsifier & Stabilizer (471 & 477) & Humectant [420(i)]), Colours (150c, 150d, 110, 102, 122, 132 & 133), Raising Agents [341(i)), 450(i)] & 500(i)], Natural, Nature Identical And Artificial (milk, Plum, Fruit & Vanilla) Flavouring Substances, Baking Powder, Iodised Salt And Preservatives (202 & 282).
